description: React component for displaying user limits warning and critical announcement bars in Mattermost, including logic for dismissing warnings and linking to more info.

methods.name: UsersLimitsAnnouncementBar
methods.description: Main React component that displays user limit warning or critical announcement bars based on server limits and user permissions.

methods.name: shouldShowCriticalBanner
methods.description: Determines if the critical user limits banner should be shown, based on admin status, license, and user count.

methods.name: shouldShowWarningBanner
methods.description: Determines if the warning user limits banner should be shown, based on admin status, license, user count, and dismissal state.
